competition.name: Kyler Murray
competition.note: listed QB1 on Vikings depth chart, described as "improving at practice, still sharing reps"

notes: NOTABLE: Two independent sources (ESPN and CBS Sports depth charts) both list Kyler Murray as Vikings QB1 in August 2026, with J.J. McCarthy QB2 and Carson Wentz QB3. This is a significant, non-obvious change in the Vikings QB picture worth double-checking closer to draft — a QB1/QB2 competition note ("still sharing reps") suggests this may not be fully settled. Wentz himself is buried at QB3.

timeline.role: QB depth/insurance in a crowded QB room (J.J. McCarthy, Kyler Murray, Wentz, Max Brosmer)
timeline.note: Vikings announced agreement to re-sign Wentz on 2026-03-19, described as strengthening the QB room; framed as experienced depth/relief option rather than the starter.

timeline.role: ROLE CHANGE: starter Kyler Murray suffered a concussion in Week 1 vs GB; Wentz relieved him and led a comeback win. Murray's next-game status described as less than 50/50 as of 9/15, making Wentz the leading candidate to start
timeline.note: Week 1 relief: 12/19 for 133 yds and 3 TD. QB1-in-waiting pending Murray's protocol clearance

timeline.role: Vikings QB1, started and won Week 2 vs Bears (Vikings improved to 2-0). One report (unverified/single-source) suggests Kyler Murray, released by Arizona, has since joined Vikings and fans are debating a possible QB change for Week 3 -- treat as rumor pending confirmation.
timeline.note: [news ~2026-09-20/21] Wentz playing well (2-0 start) but a Murray-to-Vikings QB competition storyline surfaced; could not independently confirm the Murray-Vikings signing with a second source.
